blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Forward diffusion reinforcement learning (RL)---enabling deterministic ODE sampling without trajectory backpropagation---has grown increasingly popular for efficiently aligning diffusion models. However, we reveal that existing methods essentially rely on signed reward-weighted regression (RWR), regressing the \emph{trainable policy} velocity onto rollouts from a \emph{behavior distribution}. Unbiased baseline subtraction implicitly assumes that the policy velocity equals the behavior marginal velocity---an idealized assumption violated under classifier-free guidance (CFG) rollouts, offline/off-policy updates, and imperfect online self-consistency. This \emph{behavior--policy mismatch} breaks baseline invariance and injects \emph{baseline-induced gradient drift}, destabilizing training. To resolve this issue, we propose \textbf{I}nstantaneous \textbf{T}rajectory \textbf{D}istribution \textbf{M}atching (\textbf{iTDM}), taking the infinitesimal limit of Trajectory Distribution Matching toward a time-local reward-guided target via the posterior-score identity to yield a sample-level gradient anchored at the behavior velocity without learning an additional reward-tilted target score. Tracking this velocity with an online auxiliary denoiser guarantees exact baseline invariance at the auxiliary optimum, effectively suppressing baseline drift across both online and offline RL. Extensive experiments across compositional generation, text rendering, and preference alignment show that iTDM achieves state-of-the-art in-domain and out-of-domain performance. Notably, on the challenging GenEval2 benchmark, iTDM converges nearly $3\times$ faster than competing methods while scaling smoothly to $0.87$ without collapse. Code is available at https://github.com/Luo-Yihong/iTDM

blocks.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a cornerstone for post-training generative models, advancing large language models ( Ziegler et al., 2019 ; Bai et al., 2022 ; Shao et al., 2024 ; DeepSeek-AI, 2025 ) and empowering diffusion and flow-matching models in compositional generation, text rendering, and preference alignment ( Black et al., 2023 ; Wallace et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Xue et al., 2025b ) . Early online diffusion RL methods ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Xue et al., 2025b ) apply trajectory-level policy gradients via stochastic differential equation (SDE) samplers, sacrificing the efficiency and fidelity of deterministic ordinary differential equation (ODE) solvers while incurring heavy trajectory-backpropagation overhead. Consequently, forward diffusion RL ( Luo et al., 2025d ; Xue et al., 2025a ; Zheng et al., 2025 ) —which collects clean rollouts via deterministic ODE solvers and optimizes policies along the forward noising path—has gained popularity for its training efficiency.

In GRPO-style post-training ( Shao et al., 2024 ) , subtracting a prompt-level baseline b ⁡ ( 𝐜 ) b(\mathbf{c}) to form centered advantages ( A = R − b ⁡ ( 𝐜 ) A=R-b(\mathbf{c}) ) is essential for variance reduction and relative preference learning. However, we reveal that existing forward diffusion RL methods ( Luo et al., 2025d ; Zheng et al., 2025 ; Xue et al., 2025a ) essentially rely on signed reward-weighted regression (RWR): the rollout sampler defines a behavior distribution q 0 q_{0} with marginal velocity v q ​ ( 𝐱 t , t ) v_{q}(\mathbf{x}_{t},t) , whereas RWR evaluates its denoising residual at the trainable policy velocity v θ ​ ( 𝐱 t , t ) v_{\theta}(\mathbf{x}_{t},t) . Unbiased baseline subtraction therefore implicitly rests on an idealized assumption: v θ = v q v_{\theta}=v_{q} . Yet this assumption fails in practice under classifier-free guidance (CFG) rollouts, offline/off-policy updates, and imperfect online self-consistency, creating pervasive behavior–policy mismatch ( v θ ≠ v q v_{\theta}\neq v_{q} ) with two severe side effects:
(1) Baseline-induced gradient drift : non-zero residual mean ( v θ − v q ≠ 0 v_{\theta}-v_{q}\neq 0 ) breaks baseline invariance and injects a spurious drift proportional to b ⁡ ( 𝐜 ) ​ ( v θ − v q ) b(\mathbf{c})(v_{\theta}-v_{q}) , causing unanchored RWR to collapse and existing methods to stagnate or diverge under CFG-guided and offline RL; and
(2) Coarse rollout-artifact fitting : RWR’s inherent pull toward q t q_{t} drives v θ v_{\theta} to fit few-step ODE discretization artifacts, degrading textures and out-of-domain fidelity ( Figs. 1 and 3 ).

We argue that these failures stem not from centered advantages, but from forcing distributional policy improvement into a signed regression tied to the fragile behavior-policy consistency assumption ( v θ = v q v_{\theta}=v_{q} ). Based on this insight, an ideal forward diffusion RL method should tolerate the effects of behavior–policy mismatch without drifting toward coarse few-step rollouts.

This design brings two key benefits:
(1) Principled Drift and Artifact Resistance , guaranteeing baseline invariance at the auxiliary optimum while decoupling regularization from coarse rollouts;
(2) Stable Online and Offline Reinforcement Post-Training across guided, unguided, group-wise, and pairwise setups.
Extensive experiments on SD3.5-M ( Esser et al., 2024 ) across compositional generation, text rendering, and preference alignment validate iTDM’s effectiveness: it converges nearly 3 × 3\times faster to 0.87 on GenEval2 without collapse ( ), unlocks stable CFG-guided online RL with leading DrawBench out-of-domain quality, and overcomes offline collapse while outperforming Diffusion-DPO ( Wallace et al., 2024 ) in the pairwise offline setting ( G = 2 G=2 ).

blocks.en: Advantages of iTDM. At the auxiliary optimum ( v ϕ = v q v_{\phi}=v_{q} ), anchoring the residual at v q v_{q} while regularizing toward v ref v_{\mathrm{ref}} instead of q t q_{t} eliminates both − Δ t b -\Delta_{t}^{b} and Δ t q \Delta_{t}^{q} ( Appendix A ). This simultaneously insulates v θ v_{\theta} from few-step rollout artifacts for superior visual fidelity ( Figs. 1 and 2 ) and preserves unbiased advantage centering ( Lemma 3 ) for stable optimization across guided, unguided, and offline regimes without restrictive proximity anchors.

blocks.en:
With the learned denoiser v ϕ v_{\phi} , practical baseline invariance holds up to v ϕ − v q v_{\phi}-v_{q} ( Sec. A.2 ). Yet unlike signed RWR—which passively assumes v θ = v q v_{\theta}=v_{q} even as mismatch and RL updates violate it—iTDM decouples velocity estimation from policy improvement and actively minimizes ‖ v ϕ − v q ‖ 2 2 \|v_{\phi}-v_{q}\|_{2}^{2} ( Eq. 15 ).
Approximating intractable generator scores with an online auxiliary network has been extensively validated across score distillation ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Yin et al., 2024b ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Yin et al., 2024a ; Luo et al., 2025c ; Luo et al., 2025b ; Luo et al., 2026b ) .
Despite maintaining an auxiliary adapter, iTDM achieves markedly greater stability, less distributional drift, and faster wall-clock convergence than RWR-based methods ( , 2 and 4 ).

blocks.en: Evaluation Tasks. We post-train SD3.5-M ( Esser et al., 2024 ) using LoRA adapters ( Hu et al., 2022 ) for both v θ v_{\theta} and v ϕ v_{\phi} across three benchmarks ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2025d ) : 1) Compositional Image Generation on GenEval ( Ghosh et al., 2023 ) and the harder GenEval2 ( Kamath et al., 2025 ) ( ); 2) Visual Text Rendering (OCR) ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Gong et al., 2025 ) for character-level accuracy; and 3) Human Preference Alignment with PickScore ( Kirstain et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 评价任务。 我们使用LORA适配器对SD3.5-M(Esser等人,2024年)进行后期培训(Hu等人,2022年),既适用于诉θv_{\theta},也适用于诉φv_{\phi}。 1) GenEval上的构成图像生成(Ghosh等人,2023年)和较硬的GenEval2(Kamath等人,2025年)();2)视觉文本渲染(OCR)(Chen等人,2023年;Gong等人,2025年),为品格精确;3)人类偏好与PickScore(Kirstain等人,2023年)。

blocks.en: Training Setups and Baselines. We evaluate online RL under both CFG-guided ( CFG = 4.5 \text{CFG}=4.5 ) and conditional ( CFG = 1.0 \text{CFG}=1.0 ) policies, alongside frozen-rollout offline RL in group-wise ( G > 2 G>2 ) and pairwise ( G = 2 G=2 ) settings. We compare against forward diffusion RL baselines—DGPO ( Luo et al., 2025d ) , DiffusionNFT (NFT) ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) , and AWM ( Xue et al., 2025a ) (plus unanchored on-policy RWR )—Diffusion-DPO (DPO) ( Wallace et al., 2024 ) at G = 2 G=2 , and trajectory-based GRPO-fast ( Liu et al., 2025 ) for efficiency reference.
blocks.zh: 培训设置和基线。 我们在CFG制导(CFG = 4.5\text{CFG}=4.5)和有条件(CFG = 1.0\text{CFG}=1.0)政策下评价在线RL,同时在组位(G > 2 G>2)和对位(G=2 G=2)设置下进行冷冻滚离线RL. 我们比较了前向扩散的RL基线——DGPO(Luo等人,2025d),DFmusionNFT(NFT)(郑等人,2025年)和AWM(薛等人,2025年a)(加上政策上的未确定RWR)——Difmusion-DPO(DPO)(Wallace等人,2024年),G=2G=2,以及基于轨道的GRPO-快(Liu等人,2025年),以提高效率。

blocks.en: Out-of-Domain Evaluation Metrics. To guard against reward hacking, we evaluate seven unseen quality and preference metrics on DrawBench ( Saharia et al., 2022 ) (see Appendix B for details).
blocks.zh: 域外评价计量. 为了防止奖励黑客入侵,我们在Draw Bench(Saharia等人,2022年)上评价了7个隐形质量和偏好指标(详情见附录B)。

blocks.en: Necessity of CFG-Guided Policy RL. Classifier-free guidance is vital for exploration and visual fidelity: removing CFG sharply degrades base SD3.5-M ( 0.63 → 0.24 0.63\to 0.24 GenEval, 0.59 → 0.12 0.59\to 0.12 OCR in Tab. 2 ), and unguided RL ( CFG = 1.0 \text{CFG}=1.0 ) easily sacrifices scene context despite high task rewards (left panel of Fig. 3 ). Yet reinforcing a CFG-guided policy stalls RWR baselines due to persistent behavior–policy mismatch ( Proposition 2 ), yielding blurry or illegible text ( 0.70 0.70 – 0.76 0.76 OCR; right panel of Fig. 3 ). Tracking v q v_{q} via v ϕ v_{\phi} resolves this dilemma and unlocks stable CFG-guided RL.
blocks.zh: 有必要制定有指导意见的政策。 无分类制导对探索和视觉忠诚至关重要:移除CFG会大幅降低基底SD3.5-M(0.63 → 0.24 0.63\ 0.24 GenEval,0.59 → 0.12 0.59\ 0.12 OTR在Tab. 2中),以及无制导的RL(CFG = 1.0\text{CFG}=1.0),尽管任务奖励很高,但很容易牺牲场景环境(图3左面)。 然而,由于持续的行为-政策不匹配(提议2),强化了由CFG指导的政策,使RWR的基线停顿下来,产生了模糊不清或难以辨认的文字(0.70 0.70 – 0.76 OCR;右面板图 3 ) 。 Tacking v q v_{q}通过 vφv vv_{\phi}解决了这个困境,解锁了稳定的CFG导RL.

blocks.en: Quantitative Results. In Tab. 2 , under the CFG-guided policy ( CFG = 4.5 \text{CFG}=4.5 , ✓), iTDM leads all benchmarks ( 0.97 GenEval, 0.96 OCR, 24.08 PickScore) while staying on par with base SD3.5-M on DrawBench and sweeping all seven unseen metrics on PickScore ( 6.11 6.11 Aesthetic, 32.73 32.73 HPSv2.1, 1.46 1.46 ImgRwd). In contrast, RWR baselines trade out-of-domain quality for task reward: on GenEval, NFT and DGPO fall to 22.62 22.62 and 23.87 23.87 HPSv2.1 (vs. 27.90 27.90 for the base model and 28.19 for iTDM), and on OCR, DGPO drops to 19.73 19.73 HPSv2.1 and − 0.45 -0.45 ImgRwd despite longer training while still trailing iTDM by 0.20 0.20 in OCR accuracy. On PickScore, iTDM surpasses the strongest baseline AWM by 1.28 1.28 in-domain ( 24.08 24.08 vs. 22.80 22.80 ) and by 2.95 2.95 HPSv2.1 out-of-domain ( 32.73 32.73 vs. 29.78 29.78 ), indicating that its reward gains reflect genuine preference improvement rather than reward hacking. Consistent with Proposition 2 , this gap reflects the baseline-induced drift − Δ t b -\Delta_{t}^{b} under CFG-guided rollouts.

blocks.en: Training Cost and Scaling. blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en: Aligning diffusion and flow-matching models with human preferences or downstream rewards generally follows three paradigms: supervised fine-tuning on curated image–prompt pairs ( Dai et al., 2023 ; Podell et al., 2023 ) , explicit reward maximization via multi-step output backpropagation ( Prabhudesai et al., 2023 ; Clark et al., 2023 ; Lee et al., 2023 ; Luo et al., 2025a ; Luo et al., 2025b ) , control/score matching ( Psenka et al., 2023 ; Domingo-Enrich et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2026 ) , or policy gradients ( Fan et al., 2023 ; Black et al., 2023 ; Ye et al., 2024 ; Ren et al., 2024 ) , and implicit preference learning such as Diffusion-DPO ( Wallace et al., 2024 ) , Diffusion-KTO ( Li et al., 2024 ) , and group-enumerated variants ( Chen et al., 2025 ) . Recently, Flow-GRPO ( Liu et al., 2025 ) and DanceGRPO ( Xue et al., 2025b ) adapted GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) to visual generation, inspiring refinements in hybrid sampling, branching, scheduling, and video alignment ( Li et al., 2025a ; Li et al., 2026 ; He et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Liang et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2025b ) . However, these trajectory-based methods remain tied to stochastic transition likelihoods and costly multi-step trajectory training.

blocks.en: To enable fast deterministic ODE rollouts without trajectory backpropagation, recent forward diffusion RL methods optimize policies directly on independently re-noised endpoints. Beyond group-level preference optimization in DGPO ( Luo et al., 2025d ) , DiffusionNFT ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) , AWM ( Xue et al., 2025a ) , EPG/PEPG ( Choi et al., 2026b ) , and RAM ( Bergmeister et al., 2026 ) (alongside ( Ye et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) ) formulate velocity-space updates, which RVM ( Choi et al., 2026a ) unifies at the gradient level as reward-weighted velocity regression with anchor regularization. Yet, because these RWR-style losses evaluate the residual at v θ v_{\theta} , under CFG rollouts, offline/off-policy updates, or imperfect online self-consistency ( v θ ≠ v q v_{\theta}\neq v_{q} ), subtracting a reward baseline violates baseline invariance and induces population gradient drift ( Sec. 3.4 ). By taking the step-normalized infinitesimal limit of Trajectory Distribution Matching ( Luo et al., 2025c ) , iTDM anchors the sample-level residual at the behavior velocity via a lightweight auxiliary denoiser, guaranteeing exact baseline invariance and drift-free optimization at the auxiliary optimum to enable stable online and offline RL.
blocks.zh: 为了能够快速确定ODE的推出,而不进行轨迹反射,最近的前向扩散RL方法直接在独立重新命名的终点上优化政策. 在DGPO(Luo等人,2025d)中超越集团一级优化优惠(DGPO),DFunusionNFT (Zheng等人,2025年),AWM(Xue等人,2025年a),EPG/PEPG(Choi等人,2026年b),以及RAM(Bergmeister等人,2026年b) (与(Ye等人,2025年;Xu等人,2026年)一起)制定速度-空间更新,RVM(Choi等人,2026年a)在梯度一级统一为奖励加权速度回归,并规范锚地. 然而,由于这些RWR式的损失评估了在v {v_{\theta}中,根据CFG推出、离线/关闭政策更新或不完善的在线自我一致性(vθ ≠ v≠ q theta}\neq v_{q})的剩余部分,减去奖励基准会违反基线的变动,并诱发人口梯度漂移(第3.4节)。 iTDM通过采用轨迹分布比对(Luo等人,2025c)的步态无极极限,通过轻量级辅助除尘器锁定行为速度的样本级残留,保证在辅助优化时精确的基线变异和无漂移优化,以便能够在线和离线稳定RL.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we revealed that existing forward diffusion RL methods essentially rely on signed RWR, whose implicit v θ = v q v_{\theta}=v_{q} assumption breaks down under behavior–policy mismatch to induce baseline gradient drift while pulling policies toward coarse few-step rollout artifacts. To resolve both issues, we introduced Instantaneous Trajectory Distribution Matching ( iTDM ), which takes the infinitesimal limit of TDM toward a time-local reward-guided target via the posterior-score identity, yielding an exact sample-level RL gradient anchored at the behavior velocity without learning an additional reward-tilted target score. Paired with a lightweight online auxiliary LoRA denoiser and reference regularization, iTDM guarantees exact baseline invariance at the auxiliary optimum, suppresses drift and artifact fitting, and unifies online and offline RL. Extensive experiments demonstrate up to 3 × 3\times faster convergence alongside state-of-the-art in-domain and out-of-domain performance across diverse tasks and post-training regimes.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们揭示了现有的前向扩散 RL 方法基本上依赖于已签名的 RWR , 其隐含的 v = q = q =  vtheta}=v_{q ) 假设在行为政策不匹配下破裂, 以诱导基线梯度漂移,同时拉动政策向粗糙的几步推出文物。 为了解决这两个问题,我们引入了瞬间线粒体分布匹配(iTDM),它通过后积分身份将TDM的无限极限带向一个时间-局部奖励导向目标,产生精确的样本级RL梯度以行为速度为依托,而不学习额外的奖励-悬赏目标分数. iTDM具有轻量级的在线辅助软件LORA denoiser和参考规范化,它保证在辅助优化时精确的基线变化,抑制漂移和文物的装配,统一在线和离线RL。 广泛的实验显示,在各种任务和培训后制度方面,与最新领域和领域外的绩效一道,更快地趋同到3×3×次。
